questions.question: Q1 What is the main purpose of thermal oxidation in semiconductor fabrication?

answers.b: To create a protective SiO₂ layer

explanations.a: Cutting wafers is part of wafer preparation, not oxidation.
explanations.b: Correct! Thermal oxidation creates a protective and insulating silicon dioxide layer.
explanations.c: The silicon wafer is heated during oxidation but not melted.
explanations.d: Oxidation forms an oxide layer, not a thicker wafer.

questions.question: Q2 Which gas is mainly used in dry oxidation?

explanations.a: Nitrogen is commonly used as an inert gas in semiconductor processing.
explanations.b: Hydrogen is not the primary gas used in dry oxidation.
explanations.c: Correct! Dry oxidation uses pure oxygen (O₂).
explanations.d: Argon is an inert gas and is not used for oxidation.

questions.question: Q3 Which oxidation process produces oxide layers faster?

explanations.a: Dry oxidation produces high-quality layers but at a slower rate.
explanations.b: Correct! Wet oxidation grows oxide layers much faster.
explanations.c: Vacuum oxidation is not commonly used for thermal oxidation.
explanations.d: Cold oxidation is not a standard semiconductor oxidation process.

questions.question: Q4 What is the typical temperature range used in thermal oxidation?

explanations.a: This temperature range is too low for thermal oxidation.
explanations.b: Thermal oxidation generally requires higher temperatures.
explanations.c: Correct! Thermal oxidation is commonly performed between 800°C and 1200°C.
explanations.d: This range is excessively high for standard oxidation processes.

questions.question: Q5 What is the chemical formula of the oxide layer grown during thermal oxidation?

explanations.a: Silicon monoxide is not the desired oxide layer.
explanations.b: Correct! Silicon dioxide (SiO₂) is formed during thermal oxidation.
explanations.c: Carbon dioxide is unrelated to silicon oxidation.
explanations.d: Aluminum oxide is used in other applications.

questions.question: Q6 Which oxidation method generally produces higher quality oxide layers?

explanations.a: Wet oxidation is faster but generally produces less dense oxide.
explanations.b: Correct! Dry oxidation produces thinner and higher-quality oxide layers.
explanations.c: Vacuum oxidation is not commonly used for this purpose.
explanations.d: Rapid cooling is not an oxidation method.

questions.question: Q7 Which parameter directly affects oxide thickness growth?

explanations.c: Dry and wet oxidation have different growth rates.
explanations.d: Correct! All three parameters influence oxide thickness.

questions.question: Q8 Why is a silicon dioxide layer grown on the wafer surface?

answers.a: To act as an insulator and protective layer

explanations.a: Correct! SiO₂ provides insulation and protection during fabrication.
explanations.b: Oxidation does not melt the wafer.

questions.question: Q9 Which material is oxidized during the thermal oxidation process?

explanations.a: Copper is mainly used for interconnections.
explanations.b: Gold is not oxidized in this process.
explanations.c: Correct! Silicon reacts with oxygen or steam to form SiO₂.
explanations.d: Aluminum is not the substrate material here.

questions.question: Q10 Which mathematical model is commonly used to estimate oxide growth during thermal oxidation?

explanations.a: Ohm's Law relates voltage, current, and resistance.
explanations.b: Correct! The Deal-Grove model is widely used to predict oxide growth.
explanations.c: Bernoulli's equation is used in fluid mechanics.
